title: DojoLiq Lemon Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Awaken your palate with Vaporesso DojoLiq Lemon Lime, a vibrant celebration of classic citrus fruits. The inhale is defined by the sharp, acidic punch of yellow Lemon, offering immediate refreshment. This is flawlessly combined with the slightly sweeter, aromatic zest of green Lime on the exhale. The result is a high-energy, palate-cleansing vape that is crisp and consistently bright. Formulated with a bespoke 48% VG / 52% PG ratio tailored specifically to this flavour, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid is crafted to provide exceptional clarity and a smooth throat hit. This fine-tuned blend performs flawlessly with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and starter devices, ensuring sharp flavour transmission. Created by industry leaders Vaporesso, the DojoLiq range translates the richly formulated, vivid flavours of their famous Dojo devices into a premium bottled e-liquid. Choose from 5mg, 10mg or 20mg strengths to find the perfect level of satisfaction for your everyday vaping needs.
